title: Chishin
body:
Syntax: perform chishin <target>

Description: An earthquake that also strikes other attackable mobs in the room. An earthquake that damages other attackable mobs in the room as well. Requires Earth chakra nature. Base damage: 301-357. Unlocks at level 50. Costs 44 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 9 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
